title: Length of the row elimination list
statement: For natural numbers $p$ and $\mathrm{inv}$ and lists $\mathrm{piv}$ and $\mathrm{row}$ of natural numbers, the list obtained by eliminating the leading entry of $\mathrm{row}$ using $\mathrm{piv}$ has length $\min(\mathrm{length}(\mathrm{row})-1,\mathrm{length}(\mathrm{piv})-1)$, where subtraction is truncated at zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{piv}$ is a list of natural numbers
$\mathrm{row}$ is a list of natural numbers
